species.name: Bulbasaur
species.flavor: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

species.name: Ivysaur
species.flavor: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

species.name: Venusaur
species.flavor: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

species.name: Charmander
species.flavor: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

species.name: Charmeleon
species.flavor: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

species.name: Charizard
species.flavor: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

species.name: Squirtle
species.flavor: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

species.name: Wartortle
species.flavor: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

species.name: Blastoise
species.flavor: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

species.name: Caterpie
species.flavor: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

species.name: Metapod
species.flavor: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.

species.name: Weedle
species.flavor: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

species.name: Kakuna
species.flavor: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

species.name: Beedrill
species.flavor: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

species.name: Pidgey
species.flavor: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

species.name: Pidgeotto
species.flavor: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

species.name: Rattata
species.flavor: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

species.name: Raticate
species.flavor: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

species.name: Pikachu
species.flavor: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

species.name: Raichu
species.flavor: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

species.name: Sandshrew
species.flavor: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.

species.name: Nidoran-m
species.flavor: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.

species.name: Nidorino
species.flavor: It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

species.name: Nidoking
species.flavor: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

species.name: Clefairy
species.flavor: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

species.name: Vulpix
species.flavor: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

species.name: Ninetales
species.flavor: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

species.name: Diglett
species.flavor: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

species.name: Dugtrio
species.flavor: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.

species.name: Growlithe
species.flavor: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

species.name: Arcanine
species.flavor: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

species.name: Poliwag
species.flavor: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

species.name: Poliwhirl
species.flavor: This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.

species.name: Poliwrath
species.flavor: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

species.name: Abra
species.flavor: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

species.name: Kadabra
species.flavor: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

species.name: Alakazam
species.flavor: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

species.name: Machop
species.flavor: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

species.name: Machoke
species.flavor: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

species.name: Machamp
species.flavor: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

species.name: Ponyta
species.flavor: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

species.name: Magnemite
species.flavor: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

species.name: Magneton
species.flavor: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

species.name: Farfetchd
species.flavor: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

species.name: Doduo
species.flavor: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

species.name: Seel
species.flavor: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Dewgong
species.flavor: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

species.name: Gastly
species.flavor: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

species.name: Haunter
species.flavor: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

species.name: Onix
species.flavor: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

species.name: Drowzee
species.flavor: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

species.name: Voltorb
species.flavor: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

species.name: Electrode
species.flavor: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

species.name: Hitmonchan
species.flavor: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

species.name: Koffing
species.flavor: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

species.name: Chansey
species.flavor: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

species.name: Tangela
species.flavor: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

species.name: Staryu
species.flavor: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

species.name: Starmie
species.flavor: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

species.name: Jynx
species.flavor: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.

species.name: Electabuzz
species.flavor: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

species.name: Magmar
species.flavor: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

species.name: Magikarp
species.flavor: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

species.name: Gyarados
species.flavor: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

species.name: Eevee
species.flavor: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

species.name: Vaporeon
species.flavor: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

species.name: Jolteon
species.flavor: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

species.name: Flareon
species.flavor: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Porygon
species.flavor: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

species.name: Zapdos
species.flavor: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.

species.name: Dratini
species.flavor: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

species.name: Dragonair
species.flavor: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

species.name: Mewtwo
species.flavor: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

species.name: Sprigatito
species.flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
